title: Maxime Rochkoulets
text:
My name is Maxime, I’m an AI researcher working in Singapore (Genome Institute of Singapore).
Currently I mostly work on DNA/RNA foundation models.
I obtained my MSc in CS from KU Leuven, where I wrote a thesis called Improving Tensor Decoupling with Scaling and Smoothing link. Later on, this work was continued an turned into a paper link.
I’m open to PhD opportunities :) so please do not hesitate to contact me.
